items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions Steve Lacy only in response to the interviewer's prompt, without providing any personal anecdote, collaboration, or direct interaction history.

ctx.x: Steve Lacy. My government, the way that I pay all these taxes every year, and I’m sure Dizzy did, the way they give us $20,000, a meager sum, and call it Life Achievement Award! Get out of here! I criticized them at a meeting, right after I got my twenty. I said
Good timing, after instead of before.
